menus.name: Edomae omakase
menus.note: About 21 courses at an eight-seat counter. The ticket is $413.91, including tax and service; drinks are extra and tips are not accepted.

bookingOpens: Online on Resy as prepaid tickets. Tables open 30 days ahead to the day, at midnight Montréal time. First-time guests must show photo ID matching the name on the booking.
cancellation: Tickets are not refundable, but can be passed to someone else (call ahead to change the name). Late arrivals miss courses, which are not made up or refunded.
groups: Groups of more than four, private dining and events by email or text message.
dressCode: No dress code is stated, but guests are asked not to wear perfume, cologne or strong deodorant.
children: Guests under 12 by arrangement before booking. No babies or toddlers.
